visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A group of people gathers around a woman wearing a yellow dress and a white blazer sitting on a chair in a room with white walls. Two men and two women stand around her, pointing their fingers toward her as if preparing to lift her. The lighting is bright and even, suggesting an indoor studio or event venue. (2) The four individuals attempt to lift the seated woman using only their index fingers placed under her armpits and knees; however, they struggle, and her body barely moves. Their facial expressions show effort followed by laughter as they fail. (3) The group then performs a ritual where they stack their hands one by one over the seated woman's head without touching her. They look focused, and their hands move in a coordinated rhythm before they quickly pull their hands away. (4) Immediately after the ritual, they attempt to lift her again with their fingers. This time, they successfully hoist her high into the air with ease. The woman in the chair smiles widely and waves her hands, while the lifters show expressions of shock and excitement. (5) A man with a beard wearing a brown suit sits in the chair next. The group gathers around him, attempting the same lifting technique. Despite their visible straining and the man's concentrated expression, he remains firmly on the chair. (6) The camera cuts to a short-haired man in a white t-shirt and then a man in a patterned jacket with a red bowtie, both being successfully lifted by the group. They are raised several feet off the ground, laughing and shouting in surprise. (7) The video concludes with the man in the brown suit standing up, while the others laugh and point at him. He appears jokingly dejected as the group mocks his weight or the failure of the 'magic' on him.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A high-pitched, enthusiastic female voice explains an experiment over an upbeat, fast-tempo electronic BGM with a strong, driving beat. Short, rhythmic vocal bursts from the group create an atmosphere of anticipation. (2) The group counts '1, 2, 3' in unison with a rising pitch contour. This is followed by a sharp comic 'thud' sound effect and collective groans of effort as they fail the lift. (3) A sudden 'whoosh' transition SFX marks a shift. The BGM continues as rhythmic clapping and intense whispering are heard during a ritual sequence. (4) Another loud count '1, 2, 3' leads into an explosion of high-arousal screaming, cheering, and laughter from multiple voices. A bright 'ting' SFX accompanies the successful lift. (5) A deep, resonant male voice (壯壯) speaks with confident, slow prosody. This is punctuated by a cartoonish 'fail' SFX and a burst of recorded laugh-track style laughter as the group struggles to lift him. (6) Repeated sequences of counting followed by explosive cheering and 'Wa!' sounds occur as others are lifted. Each successful lift is punctuated by an impact SFX. (7) The audio ends with a chaotic mix of overlapping laughter, teasing comments in a friendly, humorous tone, and the BGM fading out on a final electronic sting.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to entertain the audience by testing a popular 'urban legend' finger-lifting trick. It uses a comedic structure to show the contrast between successfully lifting smaller individuals and the humorous failure to lift a larger friend, leveraging social interaction and group energy.
